ui.notOnScreen: The part this tour explains isn't on this page yet.
ui.busyTrade: The tour can play once your trade is closed.
ui.busyDialog: Close the window that's open first, then try again.
ui.guideLead: A short tour of each feature. Play one again any time, or tap the ? button on any page.

welcome.title: Welcome tour
welcome.description: Every TRY-REX feature in one minute.

hello.title: Hi!
hello.text: This is the Dashboard: your progress, streak and skills all gather here. The tour takes just a minute.

game.title: Trading Game
game.text: Practise BUY, SELL or WAIT decisions on real historical charts, one round at a time.

demo.title: Demo Account
demo.textGuest: A ${balance, number} virtual account for practising trading on historical data. Sign in first, then finish {sessions} Trading Game sessions.
demo.textOpen: A ${balance, number} virtual account for practising trading on historical data. It's already open for you.
demo.textLocked: A ${balance, number} virtual account for practising trading on historical data. It opens after {needed} Trading Game sessions ({sessions}/{needed}).

learn.title: Belajar 101 and the Glossary
learn.text: Lessons from forex basics to trading psychology, with charts from real data. Tap any dotted-underlined term, anywhere, to see what it means.

settings.title: Settings
settings.text: Choose the language, theme, an easy-to-read font and the text size. Your profile and password are here too.

help.title: The ? button
help.text: Tap it any time to replay the tour of the page you're on. Every tour is in the Guide.

trading-game.title: Trading Game
trading-game.description: The chart, the market situation, BUY/SELL/WAIT and XP.

pair.title: Pair and timeframe
pair.text: The currency pair you're reading and how much time each candle covers. H4 means one candle is 4 hours.

chart.title: Chart and zones
chart.text: The candles are real price data. The horizontal bands mark support and resistance areas.

situation.title: Market situation
situation.text: The chart summed up in words, worked out from the same candles. Tap an underlined term to see what it means.

decision.title: BUY, SELL or WAIT
decision.text: Pick where you think price will go. WAIT is a real answer too.

submit.title: Send your answer
submit.text: Once you send it, the next {n} candles open: one example of what could happen, not proof your analysis was right or wrong. AI Explanation then explains the reasons from the chart.

progress.title: Round progress
progress.text: These boxes fill in as you answer, with your XP and time. XP raises your level.

level.title: Difficulty
level.text: Start on Easy, then move up when you're comfortable. Harder levels give more XP.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Your numbers, daily goal, streak, calendar, skills and activity.

stats.title: Your numbers
stats.text: Every one is worked out from your own answers. Where there's no data yet, you'll see a —.

goal.title: Daily goal
goal.text: The target from your starting quiz, next to what you've answered today.

streak.title: Streak
streak.text: The days in a row you've practised. One question a day is enough to keep it.

calendar.title: Practice calendar
calendar.text: One square for each day. It fills in on the days you practise.

skills.title: Skills
skills.text: Four basic trading skills. Each says “Not tested yet” until questions start testing it.

challenge.title: Daily challenge
challenge.text: One question for today, picked by the date. Its button opens that question in the Trading Game.

belajar.title: Belajar 101
belajar.description: Levels, lessons, level exams and the Glossary.

level.title: Levels
level.text: The lessons are grouped into levels, from forex basics to trading psychology. Level 1 is open from the start.

lesson.title: Lessons
lesson.text: Each lesson has text, worked examples and charts from real data. Mark it done once it makes sense.

exam.title: Level exam
exam.text: Passing the exam opens the next level. You need {pass} right answers out of {q}.

kamus.title: Glossary
kamus.text: Every trading term in a sentence or two. The same terms can be tapped right inside the lessons and the Trading Game.

akun-latihan.title: Demo Account
akun-latihan.description: The Demo Account's tabs. Shows once the Demo Account is open.

akun.title: Account
akun.text: Your account's dashboard: balance, Disiplin and Stage progress.

trading.title: Trading
trading.text: A chart that moves in real time over historical price data. BUY or SELL, always with an SL and a TP.

jurnal.title: Journal
jurnal.text: Every closed trade is recorded here automatically, with Rex's comments. Ask Rex is here too.

riwayat.title: History
riwayat.text: Your earlier accounts, with their journals.

kalkulator.title: Calculator
kalkulator.text: Work out a position's profit, loss and margin before you open it.

tips.title: Rex's tips
tips.text: Tips you've already seen can be read again here.

language.title: Language
language.text: Indonesian or English. When you're signed in, your choice is saved to your account too.

theme.title: Theme
theme.text: Dark, light, or follow your device. Appearance choices are saved on this device.

font.title: Font and size
font.text: There's a dyslexia-friendly font and an easy-to-read one. Below them, you can enlarge the text across the whole site.

motion.title: Motion
motion.text: Choose Reduce if animations get in the way.

profil.title: Profile
profil.text: Your photo, display name and username.

latihan.title: Practice
latihan.text: The training plan from your quiz, retake the quiz, or reset your progress.
